title: One-factor rigidity at three sparse 3×3 matrix-multiplication seeds
current_formal_scope: Each of the three seed projects completed a Lean 4.33.1 replay of 71 source modules and six selected declarations: 213 source modules and 18 selected declarations in total. The selected declarations use only standard kernel axioms, without admitted proofs, native evaluation or unknown axioms. The proof sources, matrix data and audit records are supplied in the companion repository.
